description: This file defines the `GlobalConfigurationRepositoryWrapper` class, which is a Spring service that wraps around a `GlobalConfigurationRepository` to add null checking, error handling, caching, and cache eviction functionalities related to global configuration properties within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service class providing a wrapper around the repository for configuration properties, with added caching, error handling, and cache eviction capabilities.

methods.name: GlobalConfigurationRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with a given `GlobalConfigurationRepository`.

methods.name: findOneByNameWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property by name, throws exception if not found, with caching enabled.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a configuration property to the repository.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes changes of a configuration property to the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a configuration property from the repository.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Evicts the cache entry for a configuration property by name.
